Title: 491545-2026: France – Construction work for sports facilities – Construction of a sports facility within the ZAC Bossut in Pontoise (95)
Agent_1_relevancy_explanation: New construction of a structurally relevant sports building (large multi-purpose hall with stands and ancillary rooms) — sports buildings are always of interest for sbp; also interesting because of the explicit timber load-bearing structure. Location in France (not DACH) slightly reduces the priority.
titel: Construction of a sports hall in the ZAC Bossut in Pontoise (95)
kurzbeschreibung: In the ZAC Bossut in Pontoise, a new sports centre is being built with a large multi-sports hall with 150 spectator seats as well as a specialised hall for combat sports and physical expression. The new building relies heavily on exposed timber structures, concrete with recycled aggregates and an envelope made of hemp concrete. Extensive greening, natural lighting and ventilation as well as green roofs are the focus of an ambitious, environmentally oriented concept (BEPOS ready). The notice concerns the award of construction works (shell, timber/metal structure, fit-out, MEP, etc.).
wettbewerb_art: Award of construction works for a sports building (no design competition)
gewinner: Several construction companies per lot (including SOC NOUVELLE REGIONALE DU BATIMENT; LES CHARPENTIERS DE L'ATLANTIQUE; colas etablissement gennevilliers nord idf; SAREY; SARL BILLIET; METALLERIE - DECORATION - STORES; SEM BAT; MONTI; STTS; GD THERMIQUE; GROUPE EMILE DUFOUR)
gewinner_rolle: Construction companies / executing firms for various lots (shell, timber/metal construction, fit-out, MEP, external works)
gewinner_kontakt: Total value of the contracts awarded in this notice: 5411407 EUR (construction works, multiple lots)
projektbeteiligte:
Client: SPL Cergy Pontoise Aménagement, Immeuble le Verger Rue de la Gare, 95015 Cergy, France (cpa@cergypontoise-amenagement.fr).
Executing firms per lot (selection):
- LOT-0001 VRD / Espaces Verts: colas etablissement gennevilliers nord idf, 2 Imp Des Petits Marais, 92230 Gennevilliers, France.
- LOT-0002 Gros Oeuvre: SOC NOUVELLE REGIONALE DU BATIMENT, 23 Rue Du Plessis, 95120 Ermont, France.
- LOT-0003 Charpente Bois & Metal / Revêtements de Façades: LES CHARPENTIERS DE L'ATLANTIQUE, Ld Bellevue, 85600 La Boissiere-De-Montaigu, France.
- LOT-0004 Étanchéité / Couverture: SAREY, 24 Av Chateaubriand, 78250 Mezy-Sur-Seine, France.
- LOT-0005 Menuiseries Extérieures Bois: SARL BILLIET, 1 Rte De Socx, 59380 Bierne, France.
- LOT-0006 Métallerie / Murs Rideaux: METALLERIE - DECORATION - STORES, 15 Rue Marie Curie, 91700 Villiers-Sur-Orge, France.
- LOT-0007 & LOT-0008 Innenausbau (Tischler, Trennwände, Decken): SEM BAT, 1 Rue Langevin, 78130 Les Mureaux, France.
- LOT-0009 Peinture / Nettoyage: MONTI, 82 Che La Chapelle Saint Antoine, 95300 Ennery, France.
- LOT-0010 Revêtements de Sol / Faïence: STTS, 40 Rue Du Commerce, 51350 Cormontreuil, France.
- LOT-0013 Plomberie - Chauffage - Ventilation: GD THERMIQUE, 52 Che Des Boeufs, 95540 Mery-Sur-Oise, France.
- LOT-0014 Électricité Courants Forts - Courants Faibles: GROUPE EMILE DUFOUR, 16 Rue Gutenberg, 95420 Magny-En-Vexin, France.
relevanzbewertung_begruendung:
- Sports building (sports hall) generally within sbp’s focus, but rather medium-sized municipal new build
- Structure with exposed timber frame and concrete with recycled aggregates is architecturally interesting, but no exceptionally large span is apparent
- Project status: construction works already awarded, structural design therefore completed and not part of this tender
- Location France, outside the strategically prioritised regions (DACH, Africa) for acquisition of building projects
checking_engineer_begruendung:
- Notice concerns construction works only, no tender for checking engineer or independent structural checking services
- Project is located in France; a formalised checking engineer role as in Germany is typically not tendered
- Construction volume moderate (~5.4 million EUR), rather a local project without indication of exceptional structural complexity
- No indications of a separate later award of independent checking services
baukosten_erklaerung: Read from the notice: value of all contracts awarded in this notice (construction works) = 5 411 407 EUR; adopted as an approximation for cost groups 300/400.
naechste_schritte: No active steps recommended. Document the project as a reference observation for timber-hybrid sports halls with hemp concrete and green roofs, but do not specifically contact either the winners or the client.
notes: The TED notice is an award notice for construction works (lots 1–14) for the new construction of the Gymnase Bossut in the ZAC Bossut, Pontoise. The design (architecture/structure) was not part of this publication and is likely to have been awarded earlier. The structure combines exposed timber frames, concrete with recycled aggregates and hemp concrete as envelope material, with a focus on daylight, natural ventilation and greening (BEPOS ready). For sbp the project is interesting in terms of content, but due to its size, location and advanced project status it is only of limited relevance for acquisition.
